mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT f.id, f.updates_id, f.service_intro_id, f.create_time, u.title, u.picture, u.content, 'updates' AS source_type FROM feed f LEFT JOIN updates u ON f.updates_id = u.id WHERE f.updates_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT f.id, f.updates_id, f.service_intro_id, f.create_time, si.title, si.picture, si.content, 'service-intro' AS source_type FROM feed f LEFT JOIN service_intro si ON f.service_intro_id = si.id WHERE f.service_intro_id IS NOT NULL ) AS t ORDER BY t.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
